parsed.title: Incorrect variable name in sensor signal
parsed.detail: The `readSuggestions` function uses `unit.issue` for fix units, but the `unit` object passed from `buildEnvelope` (line 1132) uses `unit.id` for features and `unit.number` for fixes. This will result in `undefined` in the `command` string for fix units.

parsed.title: Validator mismatch for AC7
parsed.detail: The validator for AC7 uses `grep -c "unit-route"` on a specific list of 14 files. However, the `SPEC.md` (Scope section) and `progress.md` (P4 task) claim this census includes tutorial files (e.g., `docs/workflow/FEATURE_WORKFLOW.md`). The grep command in the validator does not include the `docs/workflow/` directory, so it will fail to verify the tutorial files mentioned in the requirement.
